source.note: Directory summaries: 22 trails; 4 lifts (2 doubles, a triple, a T-bar). The 250-acre figure comes from a merged summary and looks high for 22 trails on ~700 ft vertical — low confidence. Lift types (2026-09-30) from the directory summary above: 2 doubles + 1 triple (3 chairlifts) and 1 T-bar = 4. SkiCentral (search summary, https://www.skicentral.com/labradormountain.html) lists 6 lifts: 1 triple, 2 doubles and 3 surface lifts — see conflicts.
Night skiing inferred from published hours running to 9 PM Tue-Sat.

character: Smaller Central New York ski area on NY-91 north of Truxton with about 700 ft (213 m) of vertical, served by two double chairs, a triple and a T-bar, and open into the evening on most weeknights. It shares an operator and a combined season pass with nearby Song Mountain.

season.notes: OnTheSnow projects Dec 11, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 opening date and no historical opening dates found in research. 2026-27 SkiCNY season passes (one pass valid at Song and Labrador, '2 mountains for 1 price') went on sale in spring 2026; spring pricing ran through Wed Apr 15, 2026 with a Buddy Pass and a $25 Heuga's Alpine voucher, and an 'Early Fall 2026-27' rate page exists. Operator context: in 2025 a NY State Supreme Court justice ruled that Intermountain Management violated the Donnelly Act by buying and closing nearby Toggenburg in 2021; remedies were pending as of Aug 2025 reporting.
